title: LiveDebugInput
description: Schema for the --initial-logs input file passed to parse_and_triage.py --mode live-debug. Provides the initial context already gathered before the live debug session starts.

initial_symptom.description: Free-text description of the observed failure. If omitted, extracted from the HSD description via Co-Design HSD MCP.

testcase_name.description: Name of the testcase that triggered the failure (e.g. 'dsa_focus_tests', 'cpm_variant_dmr'). If omitted, resolved via NGA MCP.

testcase_command.description: Full command used to run the testcase (rocket/atlas invocation, custom tool command, python script invocation, etc.).

testcase_type.description: Type of testcase runner. Controls how the agent infers log enablement steps.

server.description: Hostname or IP of the test server (used when --execution-mode ssh). Overrides the --server CLI flag if provided.

initial_logs_collected.description: Logs already collected before the live debug session starts. The agent will not re-request these unless a re-run is explicitly needed.

category.description: Log category name matching log_taxonomy.md (e.g. 'register_dump', 'dmesg_kernel', 'swerror_dump') or a free-form name for custom logs.

content.description: Full text content of the collected log. Either 'content' or 'file_path' must be provided.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the log file on the local machine or accessible share. Either 'content' or 'file_path' must be provided.

collected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the log was collected (e.g. '2026-05-06T10:15:00').

collection_command.description: The command that was run to collect this log. Useful for the agent to understand what was already attempted.

notes.description: Any engineer notes about this log (e.g. 'collected after first hang', 'partial output — device reset mid-run').

additional_context.description: Any other relevant context the engineer wants to provide (e.g. recent code changes, platform config, workarounds tried).

examples.initial_symptom: DSA hangs indefinitely under multi-source reduce workload with 4 engines active

initial_logs_collected.notes: Collected immediately after hang was observed

examples.additional_context: Issue first appeared after upgrading to BIOS 0x45. Passes on single-engine runs.
